cves.summary: The labeled-response module in UnrealIRCd 6.0.0 before 6.2.7.1 does not escape the IRCv3 "label" message tag when echoing it into replies, which allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.
cves.kev_name: UnrealIRCd Improper Neutralization of Delimiters Vulnerability

cves.summary: The Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket (/tmp/dynamic_socket) without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.
cves.kev_name: Check Point Multiple Products Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource Vulnerability

cves.summary: Wiki.js is an open source wiki app built on Node.js. Prior to 2.5.315, an authenticated account with only manage:users can use users.update to change the password of any local account, including the Root administrator and other accounts with manage:system, by omitting the optional groups argument, which is automatically allowed and bypasses destination-group authorization without checking the targ

Cloud Commander (cloudcmd) before 19.21.4 contains an authentication bypass and path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to rename files by sending PUT /rename requests handled before authentication middleware. Attackers can supply absolute or ../ paths in the from and to arrays to move any file the Node.js process can access outside the configured root, causing data loss

Wiki.js is an open source wiki app built on Node.js. Prior to 2.5.315, an authenticated user with write:pages can store JavaScript expressions in the v-slot:tabs or v-slot:content attributes of page HTML because server/modules/rendering/html-security/renderer.js adds those executable Vue directives to DOMPurify's allowlist. The sanitized output is inserted as rendered page HTML and later compiled
